title: Story premise EDU085: The Page Reads in a Different Order
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: What happens when the page is read one item at a time? Takeaway/theme: Meaningful structure and reading order matter beyond visual placement.
description: A reader wants a screen-reader-friendly explanation, but visually arranged cards have a confusing underlying sequence. A linear reading trace reveals the mismatch and a revised structure aligns the intended meaning.
